description: Interactive Power BI Gantt chart for promotions, projects, portfolios and production. From multi-year plans to hourly detail. Promo Gantt Chart helps you plan schedules, track progress, manage dependencies and spot timing conflicts directly in Power BI. Visualize project portfolios, trade promotions, production schedules, maintenance plans or R&D roadmaps in one interactive timeline. Expand hierarchies, compare planned and actual dates, track milestones and cross-filter other report visuals. Optimized for smooth interaction with 10,000+ rows. Built for FMCG. Adaptable to any timeline. The field wells retain FMCG names such as Promo, Customer, Brand and ATL, but map cleanly to any business data. A Promo can be a project, task, work order, booking or campaign. Grouping can represent programmes, assets, vehicles or channels. Start free, with 14 days of Pro included. Free supports up to 100 data rows. The Pro trial starts automatically on first use. Afterwards, the visual returns to Free. Pro starts at €199 per month per country, excluding VAT, for unlimited users, billed monthly or annually. Explore Pro licensing Free: build an interactive timeline Horizontal timeline bars with Year zoom and quarter, month or period headers.
